title: INSPIRE Scholarship (DST)
provider: Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India
description: Scholarship for Pursuing Higher Education in Science (SHE) under INSPIRE awards students who are top 1% in Class 12 board exams and pursue B.Sc. or Integrated M.Sc. in natural/basic sciences.
eligibility: Top 1% in Class 12 state board or CBSE; enrolled in B.Sc./Int. M.Sc. in natural sciences

deadline.note: Online applications open after Class 12 results

title: NTSE Scholarship (NCERT)
provider: NCERT (National Council of Educational Research and Training)
description: India's most prestigious scholarship for Class 10 students based on state-level and national-level tests. Covers all streams and is renewable through graduation and postgraduation.
eligibility: Class 10 students; must qualify Stage 1 (State) and Stage 2 (National) NTSE

deadline.note: Stage 1 (state-level) registration — check your state board website

title: PM YASASVI Scholarship
provider: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India
description: PM Young Achievers Scholarship Award Scheme for Vibrant India for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in Class 9 and Class 11.
eligibility: OBC / EBC / DNT students; Class 9 or 11; family income < ₹2.5 lakh/year

deadline.note: Exam conducted by NTA; check NTA website for dates

title: Central Sector Scholarship (NSP)
provider: Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
description: For students who secured above 80th percentile in Class 12 and are pursuing regular graduate courses from recognized colleges. One of India's largest scholarship programs.
eligibility: Above 80th percentile in Class 12; pursuing full-time UG; family income < ₹8 lakh/year

deadline.note: Apply on NSP portal after Class 12 results

title: Google STEP Internship
description: Student Training in Engineering Program — a 12-week paid internship for first and second-year undergraduate CS students. Focused on students from underrepresented groups in tech.
eligibility: 1st or 2nd year B.Tech/B.E. student; strong coding skills; typically from underrepresented groups

deadline.note: Applications open October–November for the following summer

title: ISRO Student Internship
description: ISRO offers internships at its various centers (VSSC, SAC, URSC etc.) for engineering students. Work on real space missions and technologies.
eligibility: 3rd/4th year B.Tech or M.Tech students in relevant engineering disciplines

deadline.note: Check individual ISRO center websites; applications open throughout the year

title: DRDO Internship Program
description: Internships at DRDO labs across India in domains like electronics, IT, mechanical engineering, and materials science. Great exposure to defence R&D.
eligibility: Pre-final year B.Tech or M.Tech students

deadline.note: Apply directly to DRDO labs via their websites

title: Fulbright-Nehru Fellowship
description: The Fulbright-Nehru Program funds Indian students and scholars for graduate study, research, and professional development in the United States. Highly prestigious.
eligibility: Indian citizens; graduation completed; varies by program — Master's, Research, or Professional fellowships

title: Commonwealth Scholarships (UK)
description: Commonwealth Master's and PhD Scholarships for citizens of developing Commonwealth countries to study in the UK. Focus on development impact.
eligibility: Indian citizen; completed undergraduate degree; under 40 (most categories); demonstrate development impact

deadline.note: Usually October–December for the following academic year

title: Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation Scholarship
description: One of India's most prestigious private scholarships for study abroad at top global universities. Covers diverse fields from arts to sciences.
eligibility: Indian citizen; under 30; outstanding academic record; admission to a top international university

title: IOCL Recruitment (Engineers/Officers)
description: IOCL recruits engineers and officers through GATE scores in disciplines like Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Instrumentation, and CS. One of India's top PSU jobs.
eligibility: B.Tech/B.E. in relevant discipline; valid GATE score; age < 26 years

title: NABARD Grade A Officer
provider: NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture & Rural Development)
description: NABARD Grade A (Assistant Manager) recruitment for disciplines including Agriculture, Economics, Computer Science, and General. Prestigious rural development banking career.
eligibility: Graduation in relevant field; age 21–30 years

title: AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing
provider: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS)
description: AIIMS offers B.Sc. Nursing through a separate entrance exam. This opens the door to a career in nursing at India's premier medical institutions.
eligibility: Class 12 with PCB; minimum 55%; appear for AIIMS B.Sc. Nursing entrance exam
